name: FRRouting Layer 3 Switch Driver
notes: Installs and removes static routes on an FRR router over SSH via vtysh (netmiko, cisco_ios platform). All mutating methods honor context['dry_run']. Connection params: HERD_ip, HERD_login, HERD_password, optional HERD_port. Reference driver for the Layer 3 Switch contract; see docs/DRIVERS.md. Declares supports_vrf (ADR 0014 addendum X-G, issue #755): configure_route and remove_route accept a virtual_router keyword and render it as a trailing `vrf <name>`.
